fullPassage: History, people often say, repeats itself. And looking at the historical records of the ancient civilizations, some things do seem to happen again and again. Civilizations expand, get overextended, and then collapse as in the cases of Rome, which went under in 476 AD, and the British Empire, which fell apart more than a thousand years later in the post-World War II era. But is this always the case? If so, archaeology would be pretty boring; one thing would happen again and again. But that's not what archaeologists see. Some civilizations end suddenly, like the Aztec and Inca, conquered by invaders in the 1520s AD. Those empires never had the chance to collapse as a result of overexpansion. So in the case of civilizations, "history repeats itself" seems to be an oversimplification.

det.tip: case: ① (명사) 사건 ② (명사) 경우/실정 ③ (명사) 상자/용기

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a society with its own highly developed culture and way of life"

det.korean: civilization=문명: 고유하게 발달한 문화와 생활 방식을 지닌 사회
det.analysis:
❌ ① empire: '제국'은 여러 영토를 지배하는 정치 체제로 문화 전반을 뜻하지 않음
❌ ② invader: '침략자'는 사람을 가리킴
❌ ③ record: '기록'은 사회가 아님
✅ ④ civilization: '문명'은 고유하게 발달한 문화와 생활 방식을 지닌 사회로 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: civilization = 문명. highly developed culture and way of life가 핵심

questions.passage: The British Empire, which __________ (fall) apart more than a thousand years later in the post-World War II era. But is this always the case? If so, archaeology would be pretty boring; one thing would happen again and again.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거 시제: 제2차 세계대전 이후 시기(과거)의 사건이므로 과거형
det.analysis: 문장이 과거(the post-World War II era)의 사건을 서술하므로 동사는 과거형이어야 한다. fall apart(붕괴하다)의 과거형은 fell apart. fall → fell
det.tip: fall(현재) → fell(과거) → fallen(과거분사). fall apart = 무너지다

questions.passage: Some civilizations end suddenly, like the Aztec and Inca, __________ (conquer) by invaders in the 1520s AD. Those empires never had the chance to collapse as a result of overexpansion.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 과거분사의 수동 수식: (which were) conquered by invaders
det.analysis: 명사구 the Aztec and Inca를 뒤에서 수식하는 분사구. 침략자에 의해 '정복된' 수동 의미이므로 과거분사가 필요하다. 'the Aztec and Inca (who were) conquered by invaders'. conquer → conquered
det.tip: 명사 + 과거분사 by ~ = ~에 의해 …된 (수동 수식)

questions.passage: History, people often say, repeats itself. And looking at the historical records of the ancient civilizations, some things do seem to happen again and again. Civilizations expand, get overextended, and then collapse as in the cases of Rome, which went under in 476 AD, and the British Empire, which fell apart more than a thousand years later in the post-World War II era. But is this always the case? If so, archaeology would be pretty boring; one thing would happen again and again. But that's not what archaeologists see. Some civilizations end suddenly, like the Aztec and Inca, conquered by invaders in the 1520s AD. Those empires never had the chance to __________. So in the case of civilizations, "history repeats itself" seems to be an oversimplification.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: collapse as a result of overexpansion=과도한 확장의 결과로 붕괴하다 — 아즈텍·잉카는 그럴 기회가 없었다
det.analysis:
✅ ① collapse as a result of overexpansion: 원문 일치. 그 제국들은 과도한 확장의 결과로 붕괴할 기회조차 없이 정복당했다 ←정답
❌ ② expand into neighboring territories: '이웃 영토로 팽창'은 갑작스러운 정복 맥락과 다름
❌ ③ record their own long history: '긴 역사를 기록'은 본문 근거 없음
❌ ④ repeat the mistakes of Rome: '로마의 실수를 반복'은 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: Those empires never had the chance to collapse as a result of overexpansion

ch: collapse as a result of overexpansion

det.korean: fell apart more than a thousand years later=천 년도 더 지난 후에 무너졌다 — 영국 제국의 붕괴 시점

✅ ③ fell apart more than a thousand years later: 원문 일치. 영국 제국은 로마보다 천 년도 더 지난 제2차 세계대전 이후에 무너졌다 ←정답
❌ ④ repeated the entire history of Rome: '로마의 역사를 그대로 반복'은 본문 근거 없음
